note: Rates for quantities the course file can't measure. Every value is an assumption; source says where it came from. Quantities built from these are tagged assumed or computed with low confidence.

green_surround_sod_yd.source: PLACEHOLDER: judgement. Sod band around each green (collar and surround); the rest of the grassed ground is seeded or sprigged.

drainage_lf_per_acre.source: PLACEHOLDER: workbook template ratio (drainage LF ÷ grassing acres ≈ 133-150 by par). Scaled by the zone's drainage_need. Greens' own drainage is in the green price.

heads_per_acre.source: DERIVED: Westview IL 2023 (1,166 heads / 27 holes ≈ 43 heads per hole) ÷ an assumed ~5.5 irrigated acres per hole.

practice_green_yd.source: PLACEHOLDER: a green whose centre is further than this from every hole's green (last route point) is a practice green, covered by the practice-area lump (Alex, 2026-10-19).

path_ft_per_route_ft.source: PLACEHOLDER: used only where a hole has no cart path drawn; path length = tee-to-green route length × this.
